about_the_game:
Ending it Today

You are trapped in an endless emergency staircase.
You don’t know how you got here, and there’s no clear exit in sight.
One thing is certain—you must climb up to escape.
The way out is on the 20th floor, but the path won’t be simple.

As you ascend, you will encounter two doors on each floor:

  • If you notice an anomaly, take the left door.

  • If there are no anomalies, take the right door.

With collapsing stairs and a space filled with clutter, can you overcome the tension and find your way out?

🎮 Game Features

✔ A thrilling jump map simulator – Climb the stairs, make your choices, and find your way out. A new chapter with a unique theme begins every 5 floors.
✔ Simple yet profound decision-making – Your observation and judgment are the keys to survival.
✔ Supports Korean & English – A user-friendly interface for an immersive experience.
✔ 20-60 minutes of playtime – A short yet intense experience.

🕹 Controls

  • Move: W A S D

  • Jump: SPACE

  • Interact: E

  • Flip diary pages: Arrow keys

⚙ Options

  • Sound settings: Adjustable SFX and BGM volume

  • Control settings: Adjustable X/Y-axis mouse sensitivity

Try to escape the ever-looping staircase.
Can you make it all the way to the top?
